ownership_rule: Named declaring type; anonymous class/enum-constant class-body methods excluded. Expression nodes are owned by the nearest method and do not enter nested type or anonymous body declarations. Lambda expressions remain in their enclosing source method.
counting_rule: Syntactically declared methods only, excluding constructors, annotation members, implicit record accessors, generated Lombok methods, and inherited methods. Public interface methods include implicit public unless explicitly private/protected. Public named concrete means public method with body; enclosing-type accessibility is reported separately.
source_inventory_hash_encoding: UTF-8 relative-path + NUL + SHA256 + LF, path-sorted, included Java files only
